prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0006",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 28,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01767-01768",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "そうだったのか、では続けてくれ",
      "en": "I see. Continue."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01770-01771",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "……",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01776-01777",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "……",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01779-01780",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "続きは？",
      "en": "The rest?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01786-01787",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "それで？",
      "en": "So?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01789-01792",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "続きを促す俺の声に怒りの為、とは少し違う様子で\nレヴィアの顔が赤くなる\nなにか、様子が変だな……",
      "en": "When I urged her to continue, Levia's face flushed red, but not quite in anger. Something feels strange..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01798-01800",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Refin",
      "jp": "レヴィア将軍、後の報告は私の方から致しますので\n将軍は兵達の様子を見てきて頂けますか？",
      "en": "General Levia, I will finish the report.\nCould you please go check on the soldiers?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01806-01808",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レヴィアの様子を見かねたレフィンが、助け船を出すように、\n声を掛けるが、レヴィアは其の言葉に逡巡するような間を\n置いた後、俺の目を真正面から見据えた。",
      "en": "Refin, unable to watch Levia any longer,\nthrew her a lifeline. But after a pause,\nLevia stared straight into my eyes."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01810-01812",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "いい、私から報告する\nこの街で目撃されているラティナ王女のことだが……",
      "en": "No, I'll give the report. About Princess Latina's sighting in this town..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01814-01815",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "何か、あるのか？",
      "en": "Is there something?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01817-01820",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "黙って聴け……そのラティナ王女の事だが……\n夜な夜な街に現れては街の男を襲い、\nその……精気を吸い取っているらしい……",
      "en": "Shut up and listen... About Princess Latina...\nNight after night, she appears, attacks men,\nand, well... drains their essence..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01822-01823",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "精気？　睡魔の様にか",
      "en": "Essence? Like a succubus?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01825-01826",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "そうだ……",
      "en": "That's right..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01828-01830",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "睡魔とは男の前には女、女の前には男の姿で現れ、\n男女の夜の営みを交いして相手から生命力ともいえる\n精気を吸い取って生きる悪魔の総称だ",
      "en": "A succubus is a type of demon that appears as a woman to men and as a man to women, engaging in nightly intimacies to drain their partner's essence, which is akin to life force."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01832-01834",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Levia",
      "jp": "報告は以上だ、精々貴様も襲われぬように\n気を付けるのだな",
      "en": "That's the report. Just be careful you don't get attacked yourself."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01839-01841",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "残りの言葉を急いで言い放ったレヴィアは、\n赤くした顔を隠すようにそそくさと部屋から\n出ていってしまった。",
      "en": "Levia rattled off the rest of her report,\nthen scurried out of the room, trying to hide\nher flushed face."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01843-01844",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "こういう話しに関しては相変わらず初だな……",
      "en": "She's still so naive about that kind of talk..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01850-01851",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Refin",
      "jp": "そうですね",
      "en": "Indeed."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01853-01871",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レヴィアに置いて行かれたレフィンが細い目を一層細めて\n相槌を打つ\n俺はふと、昔のレヴィアの事を思い出していた……\n十数年前、俺がレウィニアの王都に屋敷を与えられ\n『水の巫女』に事あれば力を貸す同盟者として\n束の間の平穏を得たばかりの頃、レヴィアとレフィンが\n俺の前に現れたのはそんな時だ。\n二人とも、騎士の家系に生まれ、レフィンは俺の強さに憧れ、\nレヴィアは白いドレスに身を包み儚い笑顔と白い花を手に、\nただ逃亡生活に疲れた俺の心を癒すかの様に何時も俺の側で\n微笑んでいた……。\nそれから幾年かの月日が巡り、水の巫女との盟約により幾つ\nもの戦乱に赴き、死地を潜り抜けて帰って来た俺を出迎えた\nのは、ドレスの換わりに甲冑を身に纏い、花の換わりに剣を、\n笑顔の代わりに決意の光をその目に宿した今のレヴィアだった。",
      "en": "Left behind by Levia, Refin narrows her already thin eyes in agreement. I suddenly recall the Levia of the past... Over ten years ago, when I was given a mansion in the royal capital of Lewinia and, as an ally to the Water Maiden, had just gained a moment of peace, that was when Levia and Refin first appeared before me. Both born to knightly houses, Refin admired my strength, while Levia, clad in a white dress with a fleeting smile and holding white flowers, always stayed by my side, as if to soothe my heart weary from a life on the run... Years passed, and after many battles under my pact with the Water Maiden, when I returned from surviving countless deadly missions, the Levia who greeted me was no longer in a dress but clad in armor, sword instead of flowers, her eyes alight with resolve instead of her former smile."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01873-01874",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Refin",
      "jp": "セリカさん？",
      "en": "Celica?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01882-01882",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺は頭を一振りして、意識をはっきりさせた",
      "en": "I shook my head to clear my mind."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01889-01893",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "レフィンが腰を屈めて俺を見下ろしている\n余りにも背が高すぎるレフィンは一般的な建物の中では\n頭が天井に付いてしまう為、やや身を屈めたこの姿勢が\n癖になってしまっているそうだ",
      "en": "Refin stoops to look down at me. She is so tall that in ordinary buildings her head hits the ceiling, so this slightly hunched posture has become a habit, I hear."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01898-01900",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "この部屋はこの領主の館の客間らしい、応接間ではなく\nこの部屋に俺を通したのは、高価な物の置いてある応接間は\n使わないようにしている為だろう",
      "en": "This room is likely a guest room in the lord's\nmansion, not the drawing room. They brought me\nhere to avoid the room where valuables are kept."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01905-01906",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Refin",
      "jp": "どうしましたセリカさん？",
      "en": "What is wrong, Celica?"
    }
  ]
}
